title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #20 skysbeautylai
author: BPL Staff
body:
The BPL Top 20 Players of 2021 starts today. Five Minors, five different champions, and three of those titles won by teams that lost a match along the way and came back through the losers bracket. Over the next twenty days we count down the players who made it happen, ending with the #1 on New Year's Eve.

First up is one of only two players returning from last year's list. [[skysbeautylai]] was #13 in 2020, and this year she was part of From The Ashes' run to a grand final.

At [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]] they beat NCL and Sonder before a 1-2 semifinal loss to [[Aeternum]]. From the losers bracket they then beat Trailblazers United 2-0, Ephemeral 2-1 and Tidal Wave 2-0 to reach the grand final, where Aeternum won again.

The rest of the year was quieter: 17th with Whiteout, 13th with From The Ashes at [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]], 16th with Black Rabbits, then seventh with Team NewSchl at [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]], where they won two in the losers bracket. A 9-10 record and a second straight year in the Top 20.

"Two years on the list means I'm not a one-week wonder," skysbeautylai said, smiling.

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #19 lilraxxx
author: BPL Staff
body:
Two fourth-place finishes in two months made [[lilraxxx]] one of the most dependable AWPers of 2021.

The first came with Audax Esse at [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]]. They beat cAps lOckEd 16-4 and LGL 16-3, swept ZoBros 2-0 in the semifinal, and took Fluff N' Stuff to three maps in the winners' final. [[Infernum E-Sports]], in the middle of their title run, ended it 2-1.

A month later at [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] he was with Pr1sm. They lost their opener 13-16 to Pacemaker, then won three straight in the losers bracket before [[Unforgettable]], the eventual champions, stopped them.

Add fifth place with BattleBuds at [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]], where they beat PixIgnite 2-1 before Sanctuary ended it, and the year comes to 10-10.

"Fourth twice is annoying," lilraxxx said. "It also means we were close twice. I'll take close over nowhere."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #18 Kai
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Kai]] called for five teams in 2021, and two of them made deep runs.

The best was FateChanger at [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]]. A 14-16 loss to The Setup in the first round sent them straight to the losers bracket, and they went on a tear: Under Siege, Senior J-Cubed, a 16-0 over RadiaKnights, then LGL and SussyBaka? both 2-0. Only [[Infernum E-Sports]], who went on to win the event, beat them, 2-1. Third place.

Earlier in the year, Luminescence finished fifth at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]] after beating Gothic Storm and Sonder before a three-map loss to [[Syzygy]]. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]], Heart of Cards won two 16-14 thrillers in a row.

A 10-10 record with five different line-ups, and a third place built on the IGL's calls.

"A 16-0 in the losers bracket," Kai said. "That's the map I'd show anyone who asks what FateChanger was."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #17 Historia
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Historia]] played two events in 2021 and won one of them in the hardest way possible.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]], [[Infernum E-Sports]] lost their first match 12-16 to LGL. Then they won seven in a row in the losers bracket: Nitro Hearts, cAps lOckEd 19-15 in overtime, From The Ashes, The Setup and ZoBros 2-0, and then two 2-1 deciders against FateChanger and Audax Esse. In the grand final they beat Fluff N' Stuff 2-1.

Eight straight wins after an opening loss, and Infernum's first title.

His only other event, with Team widepeepoHappy at [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]], ended in two quick losses. That's how an 8-3 player with a trophy finishes 17th: the Top 20 rewards a full year, and Historia's was half of one.

"After the LGL loss, nobody panicked," Historia said. "We'd lost one map. We had the whole bracket to fix it."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #16 m0wmeow
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[m0wmeow]] reached two winners' finals in 2021, and won one of them.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]] he was with Fluff N' Stuff, who beat Starstruck, From The Ashes, SussyBaka? 2-0 and Audax Esse 2-1 to reach the grand final. [[Infernum E-Sports]] won it 2-1, ending a run that had looked like a title.

A month later at [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]], Fluff N' Stuff went deep again: Behemoth, a 19-15 overtime win over Coarse Air, and Durendal 2-1. [[Divide&Conquer]] won the winners' final and [[Unforgettable]] ended it 2-1 in the losers bracket. Fifth.

Seventh with Dark Matter, 15th with Caelum and eighth with Team Ash complete an 11-9 year.

"We were one map from a trophy at Minor 7," m0wmeow said. "I'm still trying to work out which map."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #15 Elfy Mint
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Elfy Mint]] played one event in 2021. She won every series of it.

[[Kiedz]] took [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]] with a perfect 5-0 run. Royal Path and RabbitLeap fell in the opening rounds, then Sanctuary 2-1 in the semifinal. In the winners' final they beat Trailblaze United 2-1, and when Trailblaze United came back through the losers bracket, Kiedz beat them again, 2-0, in the grand final.

Only two teams went unbeaten through an event in 2021, and Kiedz were the first. A single event keeps the AWPer from climbing higher on a list built on the whole year, but nobody can say she lost.

"One event, one trophy, no losses," Elfy Mint said. "I don't know how to improve on that, except by doing it more often."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #14 Solaonix
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Solaonix]] beat a lot of good teams in 2021, but the result people will remember came on the first day of [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]].

Her RadiaKnights team beat [[Unforgettable]] 16-13 in the round of 16. Unforgettable went on to win the very next Minor.

Her best finish came with Shining Hearts at [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]]: wins over Ascension and AuCrow, a semifinal against [[Divide&Conquer]], then Team NewSchl 2-0 and Team Monsoon 2-1 in the losers bracket before Divide&Conquer beat them again. Fourth. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] she reached the semifinal with TacKTicK, who took Divide&Conquer to three maps, and with BattleBuds at [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]] she finished fifth.

A 10-10 record with five teams, and three finishes in the top seven.

"Every time we met Divide&Conquer it was close," Solaonix said. "Close doesn't get you a trophy, but it gets their attention."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #13 capplecrow
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[capplecrow]] called for the team that met [[Aeternum]] twice at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]].

From The Ashes beat NCL and Sonder to reach the semifinal, where Aeternum won 2-1. They then won three straight in the losers bracket, beating Trailblazers United 2-0, Ephemeral 2-1 and Tidal Wave 2-0, to set up a rematch in the grand final. Aeternum won it, completing one of only two unbeaten title runs of the year.

The rest of capplecrow's year was spent in the middle of brackets. Birds of Prey finished 11th at [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]], From The Ashes 13th at [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]], ForTheWin 12th at [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]], and AuCrow 12th at [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]], after a 23-25 overtime loss to Arroast that was one of the longest maps of the year.

A 9-10 record and one big final.

"Aeternum were the only team we couldn't solve," capplecrow said. "We'll be ready next time."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #12 Laburi
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Laburi]] spent most of 2021 calling for teams that punched above their weight.

At [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]], RabbitLeap lost 7-16 to the eventual champions [[Kiedz]] in the quarterfinals, then won four in a row in the losers bracket: Dark Matter, [[Unforgettable]] 2-1, Defiance 2-1 and Sanctuary 2-0. Trailblaze United ended the run one step from the final. Third place.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]], his St-Dreamteam beat Unforgettable 16-2 and [[Syzygy]] 16-10 in the losers bracket on the way to sixth. The rest of his year brought tougher results with Ryhope, Behemoth and AuCrow, the last ending in a 23-25 overtime defeat.

A 9-10 record with five teams, and a reputation as an IGL who gets the most out of any line-up.

"Give me five players and a week," Laburi said. "We'll beat someone we're not supposed to."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #11 lukedefabio
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[lukedefabio]] reached the first final of 2021 and lost it to a team that didn't lose a series all event.

His Trailblaze United team opened [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]] with wins over Team widepeepoHappy and BattleBuds, then swept Defiance 2-0 in the semifinal. [[Kiedz]] won the winners' final 2-1, but Trailblaze United came back, beating RabbitLeap 2-0 in the losers final to earn a rematch. Kiedz won the grand final 2-0.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] he was back in the top three with T-Spin. A first-round loss to Pacemaker sent them down, and they won four straight before [[Unforgettable]] stopped them. Third.

Two top-three finishes, both as the IGL, and a 9-8 record overall.

"Kiedz beat us twice in one event," lukedefabio said. "That's the standard. We'll get there."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #10 y1jingg
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[y1jingg]] spent a lot of 2021 in the losers bracket, and she made it pay.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]], her T-Spin team lost their opener 9-16 to Pacemaker. They answered with four straight wins: Moonlite 16-14, Coarse Air, Heart of Cards 2-0 and TacKTicK 2-1. [[Unforgettable]], on their way to the title, ended it. Third place.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]], Shining Hearts beat Ascension and AuCrow to reach the semifinal, lost to [[Divide&Conquer]], then won twice more in the losers bracket before Divide&Conquer beat them again. Fourth. Earlier in the year, Luminescence reached fifth at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]].

Three finishes in the top five, an 11-8 record, and a calling style that kept teams alive long after one loss.

"Losing early just means more games," y1jingg said. "More games means more chances to be right."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #9 Mike
author: BPL Staff
body:
Two third places with two different teams made [[Mike]] one of the most consistent IGLs of 2021.

At [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]], RabbitLeap won four straight in the losers bracket after a quarterfinal loss to [[Kiedz]]. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]], FateChanger lost their first match 14-16 and then won five in a row, including a 16-0, before the eventual champions [[Infernum E-Sports]] won a three-map losers final.

He also took Arroast to fifth at [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]]. After an opening loss they won three straight in the losers bracket: 19-17 over SpiderMonke, 16-1 over Syphon, and 25-23 over AuCrow in one of the longest maps of the year.

A 13-10 record and twelve losers bracket wins in three events.

"I don't plan for the lower bracket," Mike said. "I just seem to end up living there."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #8 Nifela
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Nifela]] lost the first match of [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] 7-16 and didn't lose again.

From the losers bracket, [[Unforgettable]] beat Aegis, Behemoth and Pacemaker 19-15, then swept Pr1sm, Durendal and T-Spin 2-0. A 2-1 win over Fluff N' Stuff put them in the grand final, where they beat [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-1 for the title. Eight wins in a row from the bottom of the bracket, and the American IGL called every one.

His year had been building to it. Team Elegy reached ninth at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]] with a 16-5 win over Unforgettable, the team he would later lead to a trophy, and Team Ragtag finished seventh at [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]] after a 16-0 win.

A 13-7 record and one of the great losers bracket runs of the year.

"After the first map we stopped thinking about the bracket," Nifela said. "We only thought about the next map. There were a lot of them."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #7 tanykeat
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[tanykeat]] called for the only team to beat [[Divide&Conquer]] at [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]].

[[Syzygy]] beat Team Monsoon and Team NewSchl, edged L3gends 2-1 in the semifinal, and then beat Divide&Conquer 2-1 in the winners' final. Divide&Conquer came back through the losers bracket and won the grand final 2-0, but nobody else in the event beat them.

Earlier in the year, Syzygy finished third at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]], beating [[Unforgettable]] 16-14 and Luminescence 2-1 before Ephemeral ended their run.

Only three events, but two of them ended in the top three, and an 8-5 record.

"We beat the best team in the league," tanykeat said. "Then they beat us. Now we both know what it takes."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #6 Skyllabtw
author: BPL Staff
body:
No player in the league won more series in 2021 without lifting a trophy than [[Skyllabtw]].

She went 14-10 across five events. The best of them was [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]] with From The Ashes, who reached the grand final through the losers bracket with wins over Trailblazers United, Ephemeral and Tidal Wave, before falling to an unbeaten [[Aeternum]].

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]] she reached fourth with Shining Hearts, winning twice in the losers bracket before [[Divide&Conquer]] ended it. Pacemaker, her team at [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]], beat T-Spin, who went on to finish third, before a 15-19 overtime loss to [[Unforgettable]].

A rifler who made every team she joined harder to beat.

"I've been close plenty of times this year," Skyllabtw said. "The trophy is the one thing on my list I haven't ticked."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #5 laavv._
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[laavv._]] arrived at [[Divide&Conquer]] in the autumn and left the year as a champion.

Her first three events of 2021 were hard: 11th with Birds of Prey, 15th with Caelum and 11th with OCIFR. Then she joined Divide&Conquer.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] they won four straight to reach the grand final, including 2-0 over Fluff N' Stuff in the winners' final, and lost it 1-2 to [[Unforgettable]]. Three weeks later at [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]] they reached the winners' final again, lost it 1-2 to [[Syzygy]], beat Shining Hearts in the losers final, and swept Syzygy 2-0 in the grand final.

An 11-8 record, a final and a title from her last two events.

"I joined in October and we played two finals," laavv._ said. "I think they were waiting for me."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #4 Solec
author: BPL Staff
body:
A year ago [[Solec]] was #8 on this list after leading [[Unforgettable]] to a final. This year he finally won one, three weeks after losing another final to his old team.

For most of 2021 nothing went right. Love&Stuff, NCL and Under Siege all finished outside the top ten. Then Solec took over the calling at [[Divide&Conquer]].

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] they reached the grand final and met Unforgettable, his old team, who won it 2-1. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]] there was no mistake: after a 1-2 winners' final loss to [[Syzygy]], Divide&Conquer beat Shining Hearts and then Syzygy 2-0 for the title. The win took them to the top of the BPL ranking.

From #8 to #4, and from runner-up to champion.

"I lost a final with Unforgettable last year and to them this year," Solec said. "The third final was the one I needed."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #3 LITA
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[LITA]], the German rifler, played four events in 2021 and finished in the top three in three of them.

She started the year with [[Syzygy]], who beat [[Unforgettable]] 16-14 at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]] and finished third. After a rough [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]], she moved to [[Divide&Conquer]].

What followed was the best two-event stretch of the year. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] they won four straight and lost a three-map grand final to Unforgettable. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]] they lost the winners' final to her old team Syzygy, then beat Shining Hearts and swept Syzygy 2-0 in the grand final.

A 13-6 record, one of the best win rates on the list, and a title.

"Beating my old team in the final was strange for about five seconds," LITA said. "Then it was just great."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #2 InfiniteBreaker
author: BPL Staff
body:
Nobody in the BPL won more series in 2021 than [[InfiniteBreaker]]. He finished the year 16-8.

His year turned at [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]] with FateChanger. After a first-round loss to The Setup they won five straight in the losers bracket, including a 16-0 over RadiaKnights and 2-0 wins over LGL and SussyBaka?, before a three-map loss to the eventual champions [[Infernum E-Sports]]. Third place.

Then came [[Divide&Conquer]]. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] they reached the grand final and lost 1-2 to [[Unforgettable]]. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]] they won it, beating Shining Hearts twice and [[Syzygy]] 2-0 in the grand final.

Three top-three finishes in the last three events of the year, with two different teams. He can play any role, and in 2021 he played all of them well.

"Sixteen wins," InfiniteBreaker said. "I didn't count them. I just remember the ones we lost."

title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #1 chreyll
author: BPL Staff
body:
The best player of 2021 started the year without a winning team and finished it as a champion at the top of the BPL ranking.

[[chreyll]] played five events in 2021. The first three were tough. Dark Matter lost a 16-19 overtime opener at [[BPL Tournament Minor 5]] and finished seventh. Team Elegy beat [[Unforgettable]] 16-5 at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]] and finished ninth. Starstruck went out early at [[Bot Pro League Minor 7]].

Then the AWPer joined [[Divide&Conquer]], and everything changed. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 8]] they beat Moonlite, Pacemaker, TacKTicK 2-1 and Fluff N' Stuff 2-0, and lost a three-map grand final to Unforgettable. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]] they were champions: IronSite, Team F&S and Shining Hearts, a 1-2 winners' final loss to [[Syzygy]], then Shining Hearts again and a 2-0 sweep of Syzygy in the grand final.

That title made Divide&Conquer the third team ever to sit at #1 in the BPL ranking. chreyll was the player opponents feared most on the way there: a 13-8 year, two finals in the last two events, and the best AWP in the league when it mattered.

"At the start of the year I was just trying to win a map," chreyll said. "Now I'm trying to keep a crown."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #20 declaration__
author: BPL Staff
body:
2022 was the year the BPL grew up. The league held its first Major, the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], alongside a run of S-Tier events, and the list that follows reflects it: almost every player on it went deep at one of the year's biggest events. Today we begin the countdown of the BPL Top 20 Players of 2022, one a day until New Year's Eve.

At #20 is [[declaration__]], the AWPer for a [[Kiedz]] team that came within one map of the first Major title.

Kiedz knocked [[Aimpunch]] out in the group stage 2-1, swept [[Neverland]] 2-0 in the quarterfinals and beat [[Artisian]] 3-1 in the semifinals. The final against [[Infernum E-Sports]] went the full seven maps. Infernum won the last one, 4-3.

The rest of the year was a grind: 12th at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], 11th at the [[BPL Major SRR]], 8th at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]], 14th at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]]. A 12-15 record that hides how close Kiedz came to history.

"Seven maps," declaration__ said. "I've replayed the seventh one more times than I've played it."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #19 siddnely
author: BPL Staff
body:
Somebody had to make the calls in the longest final in BPL history. For [[Infernum E-Sports]], that was [[siddnely]].

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], Infernum won three-map series against Bluebird and [[Setting Sun]], beat [[New Jade]] 3-1 in the semifinals, and then faced [[Kiedz]] in a best-of-seven final. It went to the last map. Infernum won it, and with it the league's first Major.

Her year around the Major was uneven: 13th at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]] after a 16-14 win over [[Unforgettable]], sixth at the [[BPL Major SRR]] with five wins from eleven maps, and 13th at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]]. But no title in 2022 was bigger, and no IGL had to hold a team together for longer in a single final.

"After map six I told everyone to forget the score," siddnely said. "One map. That was the whole plan."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #18 zuann_
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[zuann_]] spent a lot of 2022 playing one map at a time, and her [[Kiedz]] team won some big ones.

The [[BPL Major SRR]] was a round robin of single maps, and Kiedz opened it by beating [[Unforgettable]] 16-4 and [[Divide&Conquer]] 16-10. At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]] they edged Raven Song and Temperament 16-14 each and beat Unforgettable again, 16-8.

And then there was the Major. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], Kiedz beat [[Aimpunch]], [[Neverland]] and [[Artisian]] to reach the final, and lost a seven-map thriller to [[Infernum E-Sports]].

A 12-15 record over five events and a Major final.

"We beat the best teams in the league on our good days," zuann_ said. "Next year I want more good days."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #17 chiyoriinn
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[chiyoriinn]] was the AWPer on the first team to win a BPL Major.

[[Infernum E-Sports]] came into the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]] off a sixth-place finish at the [[BPL Major SRR]], where they had won five of eleven maps, including a 16-13 win over [[Kiedz]] in the last round. Three days later they met Kiedz again in the Major final and won 4-3.

The road there went through Bluebird and [[Setting Sun]], both 2-1, and [[New Jade]] 3-1 in the semifinal.

Later in the year, at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]], Infernum beat [[Unforgettable]] 2-1 in the losers bracket before Cyanide ended their run. A 12-10 record and the most important title of the year.

"We beat Kiedz at the SRR, then again in the final," chiyoriinn said. "By the seventh map I think we knew them better than they knew themselves."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #16 joyyy_cheng
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[joyyy_cheng]] won more series in 2022 than most champions did. The only thing she couldn't do was beat [[Aimpunch]] when it mattered.

Her [[Opal]] team won 17 series across four events. At the [[BPL Major SRR]] they won eight of their nine maps, beating [[Infernum E-Sports]] 16-3 and [[Divide&Conquer]] 16-8, and went into the final round needing a win. Aimpunch won that map 16-7, and the title.

At the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], Opal finished fourth after Aimpunch beat them 2-0 in the semifinal. At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]] they finished third, after Aimpunch beat them 2-1 in the semifinal, then won two more series before [[Neverland]] ended the run.

A 17-6 record. Three of the six losses were to one team.

"Every road went through Aimpunch," joyyy_cheng said. "One day we'll find a way past them."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #15 Dirfun
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Dirfun]] did his part in the biggest win of 2022, and plenty of smaller ones along the way.

At the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], his [[Infernum E-Sports]] team opened with a 16-14 win over [[Unforgettable]]. At the [[BPL Major SRR]] they beat [[Neverland]] and Fruit Basket and finished sixth.

Then came the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]]. Infernum won three-map series against Bluebird and [[Setting Sun]], beat [[New Jade]] 3-1 in the semifinal, and won the seven-map final against [[Kiedz]] 4-3. The first Major in BPL history, and the title that took Infernum to #1 in the BPL ranking.

A 12-10 record and a Major title.

"People will remember the final," Dirfun said. "I'll remember the quarterfinal. Setting Sun nearly ended it all there."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #14 [Idiot] AngelCrutcher
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Idiot AngelCrutcher|AngelCrutcher]] went 18-3 with [[Aimpunch]] in 2022, tied for the most series wins in the league, and won two titles.

The first was the [[BPL Major SRR]], a single round robin of one-map matches. Aimpunch lost the opening round 7-16 to Raven Song, then won nine in a row, finishing with a 16-7 win over [[Opal]] in the last round to take the title.

The second was the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]] in August: [[Artisian]] 2-1, Fruit Basket 2-0, Opal 2-1, then [[Neverland]] twice, 3-2 in the winners' final and 4-2 in the grand final.

The other losses were a 2-3 grand final against [[Lemon Tree]] at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]] and a 1-2 group-stage exit against [[Kiedz]] at the Major. An all-rounder on the team with the most titles of the year.

"Three losses all year," AngelCrutcher said. "Two of them still keep me up at night. Guess which two."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #13 Kairi
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Kairi]], one of two Americans on [[Kiedz]], nearly left the BPL's first Major as a champion.

[[Kiedz]] were the story of the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]]. They beat [[Aimpunch]] 2-1 in the group stage, which sent the newly crowned SRR champions home. They swept [[Neverland]] 2-0 in the quarterfinals. They beat [[Artisian]] 3-1 in the semifinals. Then they took [[Infernum E-Sports]] to the seventh map of the final before losing 3-4.

Kairi can play any role, and Kiedz used him in all of them. The rest of the year brought 12th at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], 11th at the [[BPL Major SRR]], 8th at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]] and 14th at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]], for a 12-15 record overall.

"Nobody expected us in that final," Kairi said. "Next time they will."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #12 xmeijixx
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[xmeijixx]] was #4 on our 2020 list as [[Aimpunch]]'s IGL. In 2022 she called them to another title, and then left.

The year started with a final. At the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], Aimpunch beat Cyclone, Rise of the Finches, [[Opal]] 2-0 and [[Lemon Tree]] 2-1, then lost a five-map grand final to Lemon Tree 2-3. Three weeks later they won the [[BPL Major SRR]], recovering from an opening loss to win nine maps in a row.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]] they went out in the group stage to [[Kiedz]]. By the autumn she was calling for Iterum E-Sports, who finished 12th at [[Bot Pro League Minor 10]].

A 14-5 record and one more title with the team she helped build, before she moved on.

"Aimpunch will always be the team that made me," xmeijixx said. "But I wanted to find out what I could build somewhere else."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #11 Yixl
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Yixl]] played four events in 2022, and all four ended in the top seven.

The Malaysian AWPer was part of the [[Artisian]] team that finished fourth at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], beating [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-0 and Team Neverseen 2-1 before [[Kiedz]] won the semifinal. A week later Artisian won the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2022]], taking nine of their ten maps.

They followed it with third at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]] and seventh at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]], where they beat [[Lemon Tree]] 2-0 and [[Aeternum]] 2-1 in the losers bracket.

A 17-6 record on the most consistent team of the year.

"We never had a bad event," Yixl said. "We just had a few that weren't perfect."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #10 jenapoppins
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[jenapoppins]] started 2022 at the bottom of a bracket and finished the spring at the top of one.

At the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], her Love Circulation team lost both its matches and finished last of 29 teams. Three weeks later she was in a Major semifinal with [[New Jade]].

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], New Jade swept [[Lemon Tree]], the Bot Pro Cup champions, and Fruit Basket 2-0 before [[Infernum E-Sports]] won the semifinal 3-1. They finished fourth at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2022]], and then won the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]], beating Bluebird 16-3, [[Artisian]] 16-7 and [[Unforgettable]] 16-8 on the way.

From 29th to champion in six weeks, and a 14-9 record.

"After the Bot Pro Cup I just wanted to win a map," jenapoppins said. "Then we won a trophy instead."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #9 Illus
author: BPL Staff
body:
The win that shook up the first Major was called by [[Illus]].

[[Kiedz]] met [[Aimpunch]] in the group stage of the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]]. Aimpunch had just won the [[BPL Major SRR]] and were the best team in the league. Kiedz won 2-1 and sent them home.

They didn't stop. A 2-0 over [[Neverland]], a 3-1 over [[Artisian]], and a final against [[Infernum E-Sports]] that went to a seventh map. Infernum won it, but the American IGL had led an outsider to within one map of the first Major title.

The rest of Kiedz's year was harder, with finishes of 8th to 14th in four other events and a 12-15 record overall. The Major run is the reason he is here, and it is reason enough.

"Beating Aimpunch told us the plan worked," Illus said. "The final told us how much further it can go."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #8 Sketch
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Sketch]] won two titles and reached a third final in 2022. He tied for the most series wins in the league, 18, and lost only three.

With [[Aimpunch]], he went 18-3. They finished second at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]] after a five-map grand final against [[Lemon Tree]], won the [[BPL Major SRR]] with nine straight maps after an opening loss, and won the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]] with five straight series, including two wins over [[Neverland]], 3-2 and 4-2.

That Audax title put Aimpunch back at #1 in the BPL ranking.

The Major is the one that got away: a 1-2 group-stage loss to [[Kiedz]] at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]]. Sketch was #10 on our 2020 list. Two years later he is two places higher.

"Two titles is a good year," Sketch said. "Two titles and a Major would have been a great one."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #7 Elfy Mint
author: BPL Staff
body:
In 2021, [[Elfy Mint]] played one event and won it without dropping a series. In 2022 she played five and learned how hard the BPL had become.

Her [[Kiedz]] team's year had one huge peak. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], they knocked out [[Aimpunch]] in the group stage, beat [[Neverland]] 2-0 and [[Artisian]] 3-1, and took [[Infernum E-Sports]] to a seventh map in the first Major final in league history. They lost it 3-4.

Elsewhere the results were mixed: 12th at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], 11th at the [[BPL Major SRR]], 8th at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]], 14th at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]]. A 12-15 record, and a climb from #15 to #7 on this list because the AWPer was at her best when the stakes were highest.

"Last year I didn't lose," Elfy Mint said. "This year I lost a lot, and one of those losses was the best thing I've ever been part of."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #6 KTenshi
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[KTenshi]] started 2022 with a 17-19 overtime loss and an early exit. He finished it with a trophy and four top-seven finishes.

The first event was the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]] with Glory, who lost 3-16 to [[Syzygy]] and 17-19 to Aspect and finished 27th. Then he joined [[Artisian]].

Fourth at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], after wins over [[Divide&Conquer]] and Team Neverseen. Champions at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2022]], nine wins from ten maps. Third at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]]. Seventh at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]], after beating [[Lemon Tree]] and [[Aeternum]] in the losers bracket.

A 17-8 record with one of the deepest rifle line-ups in the league.

"Glory taught me what losing feels like," KTenshi said. "Artisian taught me how to stop."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #5 rebellioniite
author: BPL Staff
body:
No player in the league won more series in 2022 than [[rebellioniite]]. She finished tied for the most, with 18.

Her year began with Cyclone at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], where they won their opener and then met [[Aimpunch]], who won 16-11. She joined [[Artisian]] next, and from then on her teams were always near the top.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], Artisian reached the semifinals. At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2022]] they won the title, losing only one map out of ten. At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]] they finished third with wins over Fruit Basket and Cyanide. At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]] they met Aimpunch again, lost 1-2, and won two more series before finishing seventh.

An 18-8 record and a title for one of the league's sharpest riflers.

"Aimpunch beat me in March and again in August," rebellioniite said. "I've been keeping count. We're close."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #4 VPLH
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[VPLH]] called for the team of the spring.

[[New Jade]] reached the semifinals of the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]] after sweeping [[Lemon Tree]] and Fruit Basket 2-0, then lost to the eventual champions [[Infernum E-Sports]]. They finished fourth at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2022]], winning six of their nine maps.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]] they put it all together. New Jade won six of seven maps, including 16-3 against Bluebird, 16-7 against [[Artisian]] and 16-8 against [[Unforgettable]], and took the title.

A Major semifinal, a fourth place and a trophy, all in the space of three weeks. With an early exit at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]] and another at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]], her year finished at 15-9.

"Three events in three weeks," VPLH said. "By the third one, we didn't have to talk much. Everybody already knew the call."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #3 Historia
author: BPL Staff
body:
A year ago [[Historia]] was #17 on this list, a champion who had only played half a season. In 2022 he played a full one, and won the biggest title the BPL had ever handed out.

[[Infernum E-Sports]] won the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], the league's first Major. They beat Bluebird and [[Setting Sun]] 2-1, [[New Jade]] 3-1 in the semifinals, and [[Kiedz]] 4-3 in a final that went to the seventh map. The title took Infernum to #1 in the BPL ranking for the first time.

Around it, Infernum finished 13th at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]], sixth at the [[BPL Major SRR]], and 13th at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]]. A 12-10 record that will be remembered for one weekend.

Historia can play any role. In the Major final, Infernum needed him in all of them.

"Two years, two titles, both by the skin of our teeth," Historia said. "I'm starting to think that's just how we do it."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #2 Skyllabtw
author: BPL Staff
body:
In 2021, [[Skyllabtw]] told us the one thing she hadn't ticked off her list was a trophy. In 2022 she got one, and climbed from #6 to #2.

It came with [[Artisian]] at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2022]], where they won nine of ten maps against a field of 20 teams. It was the high point of a year in which Artisian never finished outside the top seven of a big event: fourth at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], champions at the Challengers Stage, third at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]], and seventh at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]].

She tied for the most series wins in the league, 18, and only an early exit with Winter Solistice at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]] stopped her year from being spotless.

"I said I wanted a trophy," Skyllabtw said. "I didn't say I'd stop at one."

title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #1 SanCtuary
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Infernum E-Sports]] won the Major. [[Aimpunch]] won two titles. But the best player of 2022 called for [[Artisian]], and it wasn't close.

[[SanCtuary]] played four events in 2022 and his team finished in the top seven of all four. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2022]], the league's first Major, Artisian beat [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-0 and Team Neverseen 2-1 to reach the semifinals. A week later they won the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2022]], losing one map in ten. They followed it with third place at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]] and seventh at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]], where they took Aimpunch to three maps and then won two more series.

A 17-6 record, a title, a Major semifinal, and an IGL who made a team of five strong individuals into the most consistent line-up in the league. Opponents knew what Artisian would try. They just couldn't stop it.

"Other teams have more trophies this year," SanCtuary said. "I don't think any of them were better every single week."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #20 Pearlim
author: BPL Staff
body:
If one team owned 2023, it was [[Aimpunch]], and you will meet all five of their players before this countdown is done. But the year belonged to plenty of others too, and the BPL Top 20 Players of 2023 starts with one of them. One player a day until New Year's Eve.

[[Pearlim]] played six events with [[0v3]] and finished in the top two three times.

The best of them came at [[Bot Pro League Minor 12]]. A 14-16 quarterfinal loss to Polar Star sent 0v3 to the losers bracket, and they won five straight: Royal Flush, Devil's Don't Die, Rats 2-0, Revolution 2-1 and Helix Strong 2-0. In the grand final they beat Polkadotters 3-1. Earlier in the year they had lost a five-map grand final to [[The Nomads]] at [[Bot Pro League Minor 11]], and in August they finished second at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]] after winning their first five maps.

A 20-9 record, one of the best in the league, and a title.

"Three top-two finishes in a year is a lot of pressure," Pearlim said. "I'd do it again tomorrow."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #19 Nutzeru
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Nutzeru]] was part of the [[Bluebird]] team that reached the semifinals of the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]].

They swept [[Unforgettable]] 2-0 in the group stage and edged [[0v3]] 2-1 in the quarterfinals. In the semifinal they met [[Aimpunch]], who won 3-1 on their way to the title.

A month earlier, at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]], Bluebird lost their quarterfinal to [[Ukiyo]] and then won three straight in the losers bracket, beating [[New Jade]] 2-1, [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-1 and [[Neverland]] 2-0. Ukiyo beat them again in a five-map losers final. Fifth place.

An 8-5 record across three events, and a Major semifinal.

"We lost to Aimpunch," Nutzeru said. "Everybody lost to Aimpunch. We just got closer to the end than most."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #18 Wellson111
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Wellson111]] won a title in 2023, a few months after his team went out of a Minor without winning a map.

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 11]] his Alias team lost their opener 13-16 to [[The Nomads]], then won four straight in the losers bracket, including 16-1 and 16-2 wins, to finish fourth. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 12]] his Aeons team went out without winning a map.

Then he joined [[Sacred Raven]]. At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2023]] they won their first six maps, including 16-14 thrillers against Murder of the Universe and [[The Gigarage]], and took the title. At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]] they finished sixth with four wins from seven.

A 15-11 record and a trophy in his first event with a new team.

"After Minor 12 I thought about taking a break," Wellson111 said. "I'm glad I didn't."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #17 Kai
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Kai]] was on our list in 2021, calling for five different teams. He returns in 2023 with one team and two of the deepest runs of the year.

At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]], his [[Ukiyo]] team beat [[Kiedz]] 16-14 to qualify, then won through the group and swept Bluebird in the quarterfinals before [[Aimpunch]] won the semifinal 2-1. From the losers bracket Ukiyo beat [[Infernum E-Sports]] 2-0 and Bluebird 3-2, and lost the losers final to [[Opal]]. Third.

A month later at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] they did it again: [[DiamondOnes]] 2-0, [[Neverland]] 2-1, and then a five-map semifinal against Opal that went the distance and went Opal's way. Third at the Major.

The year ended with a hard landing, two quick losses at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]]. But two third places at the biggest events of the year are why he is here.

"Twice we were one series from a final," Kai said. "That hurts more than losing early."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #16 zenn1sm
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[zenn1sm]] was part of the [[0v3]] team that played more big matches in 2023 than almost anyone.

They opened the year with a run to the grand final of [[Bot Pro League Minor 11]], beating HydroHomies twice along the way, and lost a five-map final to [[The Nomads]], 2-3. They won [[Bot Pro League Minor 12]] after a quarterfinal loss, with five straight losers bracket wins and a 3-1 grand final.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]] they won five maps in a row, including 16-3 over [[Masmark]] and 16-4 over [[Unforgettable]], before DiamondOnes beat them, and finished second. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] they beat [[Infernum E-Sports]] 2-1 in the group stage and reached the quarterfinals.

20 series wins, tied for second most in the league.

"We were never the favourites," zenn1sm said. "We were the team nobody wanted to draw."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #15 nattyuwus
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[nattyuwus]] played three events in 2023. Two of them ended in third place at the biggest tournaments of the year.

Her [[Ukiyo]] team opened the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]] with a 16-14 win over [[Kiedz]] in qualifying. They beat Cyanide and Bluebird to reach the semifinals, lost a three-map semifinal to [[Aimpunch]], and then beat [[Infernum E-Sports]] 2-0 and Bluebird 3-2 before [[Opal]] stopped them.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] they reached the semifinals again, this time after wins over DiamondOnes and [[Neverland]]. The semifinal against Opal went five maps. Ukiyo lost it 2-3.

A 7-5 record and two medals at the year's biggest events.

"Two third places in a row," nattyuwus said. "Next time I want the other kind of medal."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #14 kuro_mi
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[kuro_mi]] played in two of the closest finals in BPL history, both against [[Aimpunch]], and lost both by one map.

At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]], [[Opal]] beat [[New Jade]], [[Infernum E-Sports]] and [[Neverland]] to reach the winners' final, where Aimpunch won 3-1. Opal swept [[Ukiyo]] 3-0 in the losers final and got their rematch. The grand final went seven maps. Aimpunch won the last one.

A month later at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]], Opal beat degree, [[Divide&Conquer]] and Ukiyo, all in deciders, to reach the Major final. Aimpunch won it 3-2.

A 9-5 record. Two maps the other way and it would have been two titles.

"We lost two finals by a combined two maps," kuro_mi said. "I don't know if that's encouraging or cruel. Probably both."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #13 gigichiii_
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[gigichiii_]] called [[The Gigarage]] to the only perfect title run of 2023's big events.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]], The Gigarage won all six of their maps: Team Neverseen 16-6, [[Caelum Scala]] 16-8, [[Unforgettable]] 16-2, PepegaX 16-6, [[Masmark]] 16-14 and [[Lemon Tree]] 16-11. Champions without dropping a map.

The Australian IGL's year built up to it. Lost Pavilion finished 11th at [[Bot Pro League Minor 11]], and Rats reached the semifinals of [[Bot Pro League Minor 12]]. The Gigarage were fifth at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2023]] before their Legends title, and 16th at the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]].

A 15-9 record and a flawless trophy.

"Six maps, six wins," gigichiii_ said. "I didn't want anyone to have a reason to doubt it."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #12 capplecrow
author: BPL Staff
body:
In 2021 [[capplecrow]] told us [[Aeternum]] were the only team his team couldn't solve, and promised he would be ready next time. In 2023 he called his team to a title.

[[Sacred Raven]] won the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2023]] with six straight wins to open the event, including two 16-14 finishes against Murder of the Universe and [[The Gigarage]]. They followed it with sixth at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]], beating Cyanide, [[Setting Sun]], Warlords and [[Caelum Scala]].

The rest of the year was harder, with early exits at [[Bot Pro League Minor 11]], the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] and the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]], and eighth place with From The Ashes at [[Bot Pro League Minor 12]]. But the trophy was the one thing missing from his career, and now it isn't.

A 13-11 record and a first title as an IGL.

"Took me three years," capplecrow said. "Worth the wait."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #11 yumezukiyomi
author: BPL Staff
body:
Only one player in the league won more series in 2023 than [[yumezukiyomi]], and her [[0v3]] team spent the whole year in the business end of brackets.

They reached the grand final of [[Bot Pro League Minor 11]] and lost it 2-3 to [[The Nomads]]. They won [[Bot Pro League Minor 12]] from the losers bracket, five straight wins and a 3-1 grand final over Polkadotters. They finished second at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]] after winning their first five maps.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] they beat [[Infernum E-Sports]] 2-1 and reached the quarterfinals. At the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]] they won three times and finished ninth.

A 20-9 record, three top-two finishes and a title.

"People ask what our secret is," yumezukiyomi said. "We just never stop playing. Somebody has to get tired, and it's never us."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #10 lumi.nyaa
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[lumi.nyaa]] played in two grand finals against [[Aimpunch]] in 2023 and took them to the last map both times.

At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]], [[Opal]] swept [[Neverland]] 2-0 in the semifinals, lost the winners' final to Aimpunch, came back through [[Ukiyo]] 3-0, and lost a seven-map grand final 3-4.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] Opal won three straight deciders: 2-1 over degree, 2-1 over [[Divide&Conquer]], and 3-2 over Ukiyo in a semifinal that went the full five maps. Then they lost the Major final 2-3.

Nine series wins across three events, and few players have come closer to winning a Major without doing it.

"Every map against Aimpunch felt like a final," lumi.nyaa said. "Then we played two actual finals against them. It didn't get easier."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #9 Seireiix
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Seireiix]] and [[Opal]] had their moment of revenge in 2023. It came in the losers final at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]].

[[Ukiyo]] had been the surprise of the event. Opal met them with a place in the grand final at stake and won 3-0, without dropping a map. That set up a rematch with [[Aimpunch]], who had beaten Opal 3-1 in the winners' final. The grand final went seven maps and Aimpunch won it 4-3.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] the same two teams met again in the final, and again it went the distance: 3-2 to Aimpunch.

Two finals, two silver medals, and a 9-5 record for the AWPer.

"We swept Ukiyo, then took Aimpunch to seven maps," Seireiix said. "That's the best CS I've ever played, and we didn't win anything."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #8 Scorpium
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Scorpium]] was in two grand finals in 2023. Three of [[Opal]]'s five series losses all year came against one team.

That team was [[Aimpunch]]. At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]] they beat Opal 3-1 in the winners' final and 4-3 in the grand final. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] they beat them 3-2 in the Major final.

Against everyone else, Opal were formidable. They beat [[New Jade]], [[Infernum E-Sports]] and [[Neverland]] at the Audax, swept [[Ukiyo]] 3-0 in the losers final, and won three straight deciders at the Major, including a five-map semifinal against Ukiyo.

The Malaysian finished the year 9-5 and two maps short of two titles.

"Aimpunch are the measuring stick," Scorpium said. "We're the closest anyone has come to it. That's not nothing."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #7 y1jingg
author: BPL Staff
body:
In 2023 [[Aimpunch]] lost one series. [[y1jingg]] called for the team that beat them.

At the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]], her [[99Lives]] team went on a tear: Wild Kingdom, then [[Ukiyo]] 16-1, then 2-0 sweeps of DiamondOnes, [[Alcheministry]] and degree. In the winners' final they beat Aimpunch 2-0. Aimpunch came back through the losers bracket and won the grand final 3-1, but nobody else touched them all year.

It was her second runner-up finish of 2023. At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2023]] her Nemesis10 team finished second after beating the eventual champions [[Sacred Raven]] 16-10 in the last round. At [[Bot Pro League Minor 12]], Revolution finished third after four wins in the losers bracket.

Two second places, a third place and 20 series wins.

"We beat Aimpunch 2-0," y1jingg said. "I'm going to keep saying that for a while."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #6 mond33__
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[mond33__]] won three titles in 2023 and lost one series. She was the AWPer for the best team the BPL has seen.

[[Aimpunch]] won the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]] in a seven-map grand final against [[Opal]]. A month later they won the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]], their first Major, beating [[Masmark]] and Fruit Basket in deciders, Bluebird 3-1 and Opal 3-2. In November they won the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]], coming back through the losers bracket after a 0-2 loss to [[99Lives]] and beating them 3-1 in the grand final.

A 15-1 record. Three years ago, mond33__ was part of the very first Aimpunch team. She is still here, and the team has never been better.

"The first title in 2020 was fun," mond33__ said. "This year felt like we finally became what we were trying to be."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #5 joyyy_cheng
author: BPL Staff
body:
A year ago [[joyyy_cheng]] told us every road went through [[Aimpunch]] and promised [[Opal]] would find a way past them. In 2023 they got closer than anyone, twice.

At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]], the IGL took Opal to the winners' final, then through [[Ukiyo]] 3-0 in the losers final and into a seven-map grand final against Aimpunch. They lost 3-4. A month later, at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]], they won three straight deciders and reached the Major final. They lost 2-3.

Two finals, decided by one map each. joyyy_cheng climbs from #16 to #5 because no team played Aimpunch closer in the biggest finals of the year.

"I said we'd find a way past them," joyyy_cheng said. "We found the door. We just couldn't get it open."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #4 [Idiot] AngelCrutcher
author: BPL Staff
body:
At the end of 2022, [[Idiot AngelCrutcher|AngelCrutcher]] told us two losses kept him up at night: a five-map Bot Pro Cup final and a group-stage exit at the Major. In 2023 [[Aimpunch]] won both of those events.

The [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] came first. Aimpunch needed deciders against [[Masmark]] and Fruit Basket, beat Bluebird 3-1, and won a five-map final against [[Opal]]. Then, in November, they won the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]], recovering from a winners' final loss to [[99Lives]] to beat degree 2-1 and 99Lives 3-1.

Add the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]] in July and that is three titles, and a 15-1 record for an all-rounder who climbs from #14 to #4.

"Two bad memories, two trophies," AngelCrutcher said. "I sleep fine now."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #3 balililmao
author: BPL Staff
body:
In April 2020, [[balililmao]] played in the first final in BPL history and lost it to [[Aimpunch]]. In 2023, she won three titles as one of them.

She joined Aimpunch in 2022, and this was the year it all came together. They won the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]] 4-3 in a seven-map grand final against [[Opal]]. They won the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]], the club's first Major, 3-2 against Opal. They won the [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]] after a trip through the losers bracket, beating [[99Lives]] 3-1 in the final.

She was #17 on our first list, in 2020, with Break the Circuit. Three years later, the rifler is #3 with a 15-1 record.

"I lost the first final to these guys," balililmao said. "Now I'm one of them. Funny how that works."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #2 Sketch
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Sketch]] was #10 on our 2020 list and #8 in 2022. In 2023, the year [[Aimpunch]] became the best team in BPL history, he is #2.

The titles came one after another. The [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]] in July, after a seven-map grand final against [[Opal]]. The [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]] in August, Aimpunch's first Major, after deciders against [[Masmark]], Fruit Basket and, in the final, Opal again. The [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]] in November, after a 0-2 winners' final loss to [[99Lives]] forced them to win two more series to lift the trophy.

Fifteen series won, one lost. The rifler is also the only player to make our list in three of the league's four years.

"The first title was in 2020, with three of the same players," Sketch said. "It took three years to be this good. I'd like to stay this good for three more."

title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #1 Chiai Fujikawa
author: BPL Staff
body:
The best player of 2023 called for the best team the BPL has ever seen.

[[Chiai Fujikawa]] joined [[Aimpunch]] in 2022 and won the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022]] in his first event with them. In 2023 he led them to a season nobody had come close to before.

The [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023]]: [[Unforgettable]] 2-0, [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-1, [[Ukiyo]] 2-1, then [[Opal]] twice, 3-1 in the winners' final and 4-3 in a seven-map grand final. The [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2023]], Aimpunch's first Major: [[Masmark]] 2-1, Fruit Basket 2-1, Bluebird 3-1 and Opal 3-2 in the final. The [[Bot Pro Cup 2023]]: four straight wins, a 0-2 loss to [[99Lives]] in the winners' final, then degree 2-1 and 99Lives 3-1 in the grand final.

Three titles, one Major, fifteen series won and one lost. Aimpunch finished the year at the top of the BPL ranking, more than 900 points clear of Opal, and the Malaysian IGL was the voice behind all of it. Eight deciders went their way in those three events. That is not luck. That is calling.

"Everybody talks about our aim," Chiai Fujikawa said. "Ask them about the fifth map against Opal. That one was won on comms."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #20 bluenerd8
author: BPL Staff
body:
2024 was a short year in the BPL: three big events, the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2024]], the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]] and the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]], the year's Major. Every player on this year's list made their mark at one of them. The BPL Top 20 Players of 2024 starts today and runs to New Year's Eve.

[[bluenerd8]] was the AWPer for [[degree]], the surprise finalists of the Major.

degree opened with a 2-1 win over [[Masmark]] in the group stage, then swept [[Neverland]] 2-0 in the quarterfinals, a result that looks even better now that Neverland have won the Legends Stage. In the semifinal they swept [[99Lives]] 2-0. The final against [[Lemon Tree]] was one-sided, 0-3, but nobody had expected degree to be there at all.

Three series wins, one loss, and a Major final.

"Nobody picked us," bluenerd8 said. "That's fine. We picked ourselves."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #19 TuxedoCat
author: BPL Staff
body:
Nobody in the league won more series in 2024 than [[TuxedoCat]]. He finished tied for the most, with 12, all of them with [[Aspire]].

At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2024]], Aspire won six of seven maps, starting with a 22-19 overtime win over [[entity]] and finishing with a 13-11 win over [[Bloom E-Sports]]. Only a 3-13 loss to nihilism. blemished the run, and they finished second behind Kabar.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]] they lost two of their first three, then won four straight, including 13-4 over nihilism. and 13-7 over [[Artisian]], to finish fifth. At the Major they beat Bloom E-Sports 2-1 before a three-map loss to [[99Lives]].

A 12-4 record from a rifler who barely had a bad day.

"Twelve wins and no trophy," TuxedoCat said. "I'd trade six of them for a final."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #18 xJavyz
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[xJavyz]] was part of the comeback of the year, and the only team to beat the Legends champions.

At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2024]], [[entity]] lost their first three maps, two of them in overtime: 19-22 to [[Aspire]] and 17-19 to ZAK3. They won their last four, two of them 13-2, and finished sixth.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]] they were a different team. Six wins from seven, including a 19-16 overtime win over [[Artisian]], 16-14 over [[Neverland]] and 16-12 over [[New Jade]]. Neverland won the event anyway, but entity were the only team that beat them. Third place.

The Malaysian rifler finished the year 11-5.

"We started the Challengers 0-3," xJavyz said. "We finished the Legends as the only team to beat the champions. That's a good year."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #17 VanixEvans
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[VanixEvans]] called [[degree]] to the final of the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]].

The run went through some of the best teams in the league. A 2-1 win over [[Masmark]] in the group stage. A 2-0 sweep of [[Neverland]], who went on to win the Legends Stage, in the quarterfinals. A 2-0 sweep of [[99Lives]] in the semifinals.

In the final, [[Lemon Tree]] won 3-0. But for an IGL whose team arrived without much fanfare, a Major final is a statement.

degree played one event in 2024, and VanixEvans made it count: a 3-1 record and a silver medal at the biggest event of the year.

"We had a plan for every team we played," VanixEvans said. "Lemon Tree had a better one in the final. We'll fix that."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #16 Historia
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Historia]] has now made this list three times, in 2021, 2022 and 2024. He played one event this year and took [[Infernum E-Sports]] to the semifinals of the Major.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]], Infernum swept [[entity]] 2-0 in the group stage and [[The Nomads]] 2-0 in the quarterfinals, both without dropping a map. [[Lemon Tree]], the eventual champions, won the semifinal 2-0.

Two years after he won the league's first Major with Infernum, Historia is still one of the players his team turns to when it matters, in any role it needs.

"I've won a Major before," Historia said. "Losing a semifinal at one still stings. I'm counting it as unfinished business."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #15 Mike
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Mike]] was #9 on this list in 2021. Three years later he is back, calling for an [[entity]] team that refused to stay down.

At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2024]] entity lost their first three maps. Two of them went to overtime. Then they won four in a row and finished sixth.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]] he called them to third place with six wins from seven, beating [[Artisian]] 19-16 in overtime, [[Neverland]] 16-14 and [[New Jade]] 16-12. Neverland lost only once all event, and Mike's team were the ones who beat them.

An 11-5 year for an IGL who, three years ago, told us he always seemed to end up in the lower bracket. This year his team climbed out of it.

"0-3 at the Challengers," Mike said. "We talked for five minutes and never lost like that again."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #14 kkayyteeee
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[kkayyteeee]] won a Major in 2024 without losing a series.

[[Lemon Tree]] went 5-0 at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]]. The first three wins were all deciders: [[DiamondOnes]] 2-1, [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-1 and then [[Aimpunch]], the #1 team in the league, 2-1 in the quarterfinals. After that, Lemon Tree didn't drop another map: 2-0 over [[Infernum E-Sports]] and 3-0 over [[degree]] in the final.

It was Lemon Tree's second big title. They won the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]] with the same five players.

One event, five wins, a Major. The rifler is #14 only because one event is all she played.

"Three deciders to start," kkayyteeee said. "After that, it felt like we couldn't lose a map."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #13 JWQI
author: BPL Staff
body:
When [[Lemon Tree]] beat [[Aimpunch]] at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]], [[JWQI]] had seen this movie before.

In March 2022, the same five Lemon Tree players beat Aimpunch 3-2 in the grand final of the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]]. In August 2024, they beat them again, 2-1 in the Major quarterfinals, and went on to win the whole thing: [[Infernum E-Sports]] 2-0 in the semifinals and [[degree]] 3-0 in the final.

A perfect 5-0 run, and the biggest trophy in the BPL.

"We beat them in 2022, and everybody said it was a fluke," JWQI said. "Twice isn't a fluke."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #12 Rethnap
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Rethnap]] called [[The Nomads]] to second place at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]], and only one team beat them.

The Nomads won six of their seven maps: Bluebird and Fruit Basket 13-11 each, Technomancy, [[Ukiyo]] 13-1, [[New Jade]] 13-3 and [[Setting Sun]] 13-8. The one loss was 4-13 to [[Neverland]], and it decided the title.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] they beat New Jade and [[Alcheministry]] to reach the quarterfinals, where [[Infernum E-Sports]] beat them 2-0.

An 8-2 record and a silver medal at an S-Tier event.

"One bad map," Rethnap said. "One bad map against the one team that was better that week. I can live with that. Mostly."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #11 Anony
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Anony]], the Thai AWPer, was one of the reasons [[degree]] went from outsiders to Major finalists.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]], degree beat [[Masmark]] 2-1 in the group stage, and then didn't drop a map until the final: 2-0 over [[Neverland]] in the quarterfinals and 2-0 over [[99Lives]] in the semifinals. [[Lemon Tree]] were too strong in the final and won 3-0.

degree have been together for a year, the same five players, and 2024 was the year it paid off.

"Four series at a Major, three wins," Anony said. "The fourth one we'll win next time."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #10 Zoweya
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Zoweya]] was the highest-placed [[degree]] player on this year's list, and the rifler earned it at the biggest event of the year.

degree had played together through 2023 without making a final. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] that changed. They edged [[Masmark]] 2-1, then swept [[Neverland]] and [[99Lives]] 2-0 without dropping a map to reach the final. [[Lemon Tree]] won it 3-0.

Back in 2021 she was part of a ForTheWin team that went out early. Now she has a Major final on her record.

"We went into the Major as the team nobody talked about," Zoweya said. "Now they talk about us."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #9 MoonRaika
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[MoonRaika]] was the Malaysian AWPer on the team that won the 2024 Major without losing a series.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]], [[Lemon Tree]] won three straight deciders to start the event, against [[DiamondOnes]], [[Divide&Conquer]] and, in the quarterfinals, [[Aimpunch]]. Then they stopped dropping maps. [[Infernum E-Sports]] fell 2-0 in the semifinals and [[degree]] 3-0 in the final.

He has played with the same four teammates since at least 2022, when Lemon Tree won the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]]. The Major is the payoff for that patience.

"Same five players, same plan, two years later," MoonRaika said. "We just got better at it."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #8 Meowcolmz
author: BPL Staff
body:
Every call in [[Lemon Tree]]'s perfect Major run came from [[Meowcolmz]].

The [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] started with three straight deciders: [[DiamondOnes]] 2-1, [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-1, and then the big one, [[Aimpunch]] 2-1 in the quarterfinals. The IGL kept his team calm through all three. After that Lemon Tree swept [[Infernum E-Sports]] 2-0 and [[degree]] 3-0 to lift the trophy.

Five series, five wins, and a Major title for a team that has kept the same line-up since 2022.

"When you beat Aimpunch in a decider, the rest of the bracket gets quieter," Meowcolmz said. "We just had to not get loud ourselves."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #7 adrina.ii
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[adrina.ii]] won a title with [[Neverland]] in 2020. In 2024 she won another, with almost the same team.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]], Neverland won six of seven maps, beating [[Bloom E-Sports]], [[The Nomads]] 13-4, [[New Jade]] 13-11, [[Setting Sun]] and Bluebird. Their one loss was 14-16 to [[entity]] in overtime. That 13-4 win over The Nomads, the eventual runners-up, decided the title.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] they swept Bluebird and [[Unforgettable]] before [[degree]] beat them in the quarterfinals.

The AWPer was #12 on our first list in 2020, after Neverland's comeback title at [[BPL Tournament Minor 3]]. Four years later she is #7.

"Four of us from 2020 are still here," adrina.ii said. "We know each other's habits better than our own."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #6 Ice
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Ice]] gave [[Neverland]]'s veterans the one thing their 2020 title team didn't have: him.

The Malaysian rifler has been part of Neverland's line-up since at least 2022, and in 2024 the team finally won big again. At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]] they took six of seven maps, including 13-4 over [[The Nomads]], who finished second. The only loss was a 14-16 overtime defeat to [[entity]].

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] Neverland swept Bluebird and [[Unforgettable]] 2-0 to reach the quarterfinals, where [[degree]] ended their run.

An 8-2 year and an S-Tier title.

"Everyone talks about the four who were here in 2020," Ice said. "I'm the one who keeps them young."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #5 ostc.x
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[ostc.x]] was on the [[Neverland]] team that won [[BPL Tournament Minor 3]] in 2020 after losing its first match. Four years later she is part of their best season since.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]] Neverland went 6-1 and took the title. They beat [[Bloom E-Sports]] and nihilism. 13-9, crushed [[The Nomads]] 13-4, edged [[New Jade]] 13-11, and beat [[Setting Sun]] and Bluebird 13-8. Only [[entity]] beat them, in overtime.

They also reached the Major quarterfinals at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]], sweeping Bluebird and [[Unforgettable]] before [[degree]] stopped them.

An 8-2 record from one of the league's longest-serving riflers.

"We're the old team now," ostc.x said. "Old teams know how to close."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #4 luminmochi
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[luminmochi]] won the 2024 Major, and she did it the way great teams do: by winning the close ones first.

[[Lemon Tree]] opened the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] with three deciders in a row. [[DiamondOnes]] 2-1. [[Divide&Conquer]] 2-1. [[Aimpunch]], the #1 team in the BPL, 2-1 in the quarterfinals. Then, with the pressure off, they didn't lose another map: 2-0 over [[Infernum E-Sports]] and 3-0 over [[degree]] in the final.

She is the highest-placed Lemon Tree player on this list, two years after the same team won the [[Bot Pro Cup 2022]].

A 5-0 record and a Major.

"People kept asking when Lemon Tree would win again," luminmochi said. "We were just waiting for the biggest one."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #3 rebebx
author: BPL Staff
body:
In August 2024, [[rebebx]] finally lifted a trophy. Soon after, she disappeared.

The trophy came at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2024]] with Kabar. They lost their opening match 11-13 to [[Bloom E-Sports]] and then didn't lose again: six straight wins, including a 16-14 overtime escape against nihilism., to finish first. After four years and a long list of teams, the rifler who was #5 on our very first list in 2020 had a title of her own.

Then came the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]]. Kabar lost 3-13 to [[division20]], fought back to 2-2 with wins over [[Opal]] and, in overtime, [[Cyanide]], and then met [[Masmark]] with everything on the line. They lost 10-13. Three rounds from the next stage of her career.

She hasn't played since. Friends say she is still playing every day, offline, away from brackets. Whatever comes next, 2024 was the year rebebx proved she could win.

"I'll be back," she told us in a short message. "Not yet. But I'll be back."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #2 Resent
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Resent]] called for [[Neverland]] when they won [[BPL Tournament Minor 3]] in 2020, coming back from a 2-16 opening loss. In 2024 he called them to the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]] title.

Four of the five players from that 2020 team were still together, and this time there was no comeback needed. Neverland won six of seven maps at the Legends Stage. They beat [[Bloom E-Sports]], nihilism., [[New Jade]], [[Setting Sun]] and Bluebird, and handed [[The Nomads]] their only loss, 13-4, in the match that decided the title. Their own only loss was a 14-16 overtime defeat to [[entity]].

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] Neverland swept their first two series before [[degree]] beat them in the quarterfinals.

An 8-2 record and the second title of his career, four years apart.

"In 2020 we won by never giving up," Resent said. "In 2024 we won by never giving anyone a chance."

title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #1 simply_perezoso
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Lemon Tree]] won the Major. But the best player of 2024 was the rifler at the heart of [[Neverland]]'s return.

[[simply_perezoso]] was #9 on our 2020 list after Neverland's famous comeback at [[BPL Tournament Minor 3]]. Four years later, with four of that title team still together, she was the player opponents feared most.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2024]], Neverland won six of their seven maps and the title: [[Bloom E-Sports]] 13-9, nihilism. 13-9, [[The Nomads]] 13-4, [[New Jade]] 13-11, [[Setting Sun]] 13-8 and Bluebird 13-8. The only blemish was a 14-16 overtime loss to [[entity]]. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]] they swept Bluebird and [[Unforgettable]] 2-0 to reach the quarterfinals before [[degree]] ended the run.

An 8-2 record, an S-Tier title and a Major quarterfinal, in a year with only three big events. When Neverland needed a round, they looked to her, and more often than not she delivered it.

"In 2020 I was the new kid on a team that got lucky," simply_perezoso said. "In 2024 nobody called it luck."
