title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #20 Xyrolizea
author: BPL Staff
body:
2025 had five big events and five different champions: PepegaX at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]], [[Alcheministry]] at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]], [[Moonlit Tempo]] at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2025]], [[New Jade]] at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2025]], and [[Cosmos]], for the first time ever, at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]]. The BPL Top 20 Players of 2025 counts down the players behind them, one a day until New Year's Eve.

[[Xyrolizea]] starts us off. The AWPer's [[Masmark]] team handed the Reshuffle champions their only loss of the event.

Alcheministry won six of seven maps at the Ranking Reshuffle. The one they lost was 2-13 to Masmark. Masmark finished fourth, with five wins, including 16-14 over [[Kiedz]] and 13-1 over [[The Gigarage]], who went on to reach the Major final.

At the Audax Invitational in March, Masmark won all four group matches before PepegaX, the eventual champions, beat them in the quarterfinals. At the Major they swept [[Moonlit Tempo]] and lost a three-map quarterfinal to [[Aetherline]].

A 10-4 record across three big events.

"We beat the champions 13-2," Xyrolizea said. "That's the scoreline I want on my wall."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #19 SashimiGoesBloop
author: BPL Staff
body:
In March, [[SashimiGoesBloop]] was playing for a team called Looking4Team. In October he was a champion.

Looking4Team did what their name suggested at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]]: they won one map in four and finished 30th. Seven months later he lined up with [[Moonlit Tempo]] at the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2025]].

Moonlit Tempo won six of their seven maps. They beat Paper Tigers, The Weekend Bois and Sugarcrash Protocol, edged Aurum Core 13-11, beat [[Round Loss Bonus]] 13-9, and beat Vitrix E-Sports 13-5, the team that finished second. Only [[Aetherline]] beat them.

It was the second title of his career, four years after his first, with [[Aeternum]] at [[BPL Tournament Minor 6]] in 2021.

"Looking for a team in March, champion in October," SashimiGoesBloop said. "Good year to stop looking."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #18 VPLH
author: BPL Staff
body:
At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]] in March, [[New Jade]] lost all four of their matches and finished 34th. In October they were champions again, and [[VPLH]] called every round of it.

Their spring and summer were rough: 34th at the Audax, 21st at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]], and a group-stage exit at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]]. Then came the [[BPL Legends Stage 2025]].

New Jade won six of seven maps. They beat [[Divide&Conquer]] 13-6, Team Neverseen, Raven Song 13-0, [[The Nomads]] 13-10, Vitrix E-Sports 13-11 and [[Round Loss Bonus]] 13-4. Their only loss was to [[Aetherline]].

It was the IGL's second Legends title, three years after she led New Jade to the [[BPL Legends Stage 2022]] crown. She was #4 on our list that year. She is back in 2025.

"Everyone wrote us off after March," VPLH said. "We've done this before. We know how it ends."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #17 caturteer
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[caturteer]] spent the start of 2025 with Looking4Team and finished it in a Major semifinal.

After a 30th-place finish at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]], she joined [[Round Loss Bonus]]. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], they swept [[Caelum Scala]] 2-0 in the group stage and [[Aeternum]] 2-0 in the quarterfinals, before [[The Gigarage]] beat them in the semifinal. Third at the Major.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2025]] they won their first five maps, including a 19-17 overtime win over [[The Nomads]], before losses to [[Aetherline]] and [[New Jade]], the eventual champions.

A 12-9 record and an IGL who turned a new team into a Major semifinalist in her first year with it.

"Nobody expected a team called Round Loss Bonus to make a Major semifinal," caturteer said. "Honestly, neither did we."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #16 xJavyz
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[xJavyz]] was #18 on our 2024 list, and in 2025 he climbs two places with another strong year for [[entity]].

At the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]], entity won six of seven maps and finished second. They beat [[Sacred Raven]] 19-17 in overtime, [[Neverland]], DiamondOnes and [[Masmark]] 13-7 each, [[Aeternum]] and [[Caelum Scala]]. The only loss was 7-13 to [[Alcheministry]], and it decided the title.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], entity swept [[The Nomads]] 2-0 and then took [[Cosmos]], the eventual champions, to a third map in the quarterfinals.

A 9-4 record from the Malaysian rifler.

"Second place hurts more than third," xJavyz said. "Ask anyone who has been there."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #15 YoJareddo
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[YoJareddo]] came within one map of winning a Major.

The American rifler's [[The Gigarage]] team didn't drop a map at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]] until the final. They swept [[New Jade]], [[Artisian]] and [[Round Loss Bonus]] 2-0 without dropping a map. In the final against [[Cosmos]] they went 2-2 and lost the fifth map.

The Gigarage were consistent all year. At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]] they won three group matches, two of them 13-0, before [[Divide&Conquer]] stopped them. At the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]] they won five of seven and finished eighth.

An 11-5 record.

"Six maps in a row without losing one, then three lost in the one series that mattered," YoJareddo said. "That's a Major final for you."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #14 d.chong
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[d.chong]] won the first title of his career at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]] with [[Alcheministry]].

They won six of seven maps: [[Unforgettable]] 13-6, [[The Gigarage]] 13-2, [[Opal]] 13-10, [[division20]] 13-4, [[entity]] 13-7 in the match that decided first place, and [[Aeternum]] 13-8. Only [[Masmark]] beat them.

Earlier in the year, at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]], Alcheministry won a 22-18 overtime marathon against [[99Lives]] but went out in the group stage. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], [[Artisian]] beat them in the group stage.

An 8-4 record and a trophy.

"Years of trying," d.chong said. "One title. I'll take it, and then I'll take another."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #13 Mike
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[Mike]] has now made this list three times: #9 in 2021, #15 in 2024, and #13 this year. Every time, his teams have been at their best when they were written off.

In 2025 his [[entity]] team started slowly, losing their first two group matches at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]] and going out. Three months later they were second at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]], with six wins from seven, including a 19-17 overtime win over [[Sacred Raven]].

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]] they swept [[The Nomads]] and took [[Cosmos]], the eventual champions, to three maps in the quarterfinals.

A 9-4 record and another year as one of the league's most trusted IGLs.

"People keep counting us out after one bad event," Mike said. "I keep counting on that."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #12 DelphoxLuna
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[DelphoxLuna]] played one event in 2025. She won the Major.

She joined [[Cosmos]] for the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], and the rifler fitted in at once. Cosmos swept Technomancy 2-0 in the group stage. They beat [[entity]] 2-1 in the quarterfinals and [[Aetherline]] 2-1 in the semifinals. In the final against [[The Gigarage]] they went to a fifth map and won it.

Four series, four wins, and the first title in Cosmos history, won at the biggest event of the year.

One event keeps her at #12. But no player on this list had a better debut.

"I got the call, I said yes, and then I had a Major," DelphoxLuna said. "I'm still waiting for the catch."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #11 EfreetsZ
author: BPL Staff
body:
Two of 2025's S-Tier champions lost one map each at their title events. Both of those losses were to [[Aetherline]], and [[EfreetsZ]] was there for both.

At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2025]], Aetherline beat [[Moonlit Tempo]] 13-7, the champions' only defeat. At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2025]], Aetherline beat [[New Jade]] 13-10, also the champions' only defeat. They also beat [[Artisian]] 19-16 in overtime there.

Their best result came at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]]: wins over [[division20]] and [[Masmark]], both 2-1, and a semifinal that [[Cosmos]] won 2-1 on their way to the title. Fourth at the Major.

An 11-6 record from a rifler who made Aetherline the team nobody wanted to face.

"We beat both champions," EfreetsZ said. "We just never got to hold a trophy ourselves. Next year."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #10 NipNip
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[NipNip]] called one of the two teams that took [[Cosmos]] to a deciding map before the Major final.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], [[Aetherline]] beat [[division20]] 2-1 in the group stage and [[Masmark]] 2-1 in the quarterfinals. In the semifinal they took Cosmos to a third map and lost it. Cosmos went on to win the title.

Aetherline were the year's great spoilers. At the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2025]] they handed [[Moonlit Tempo]] their only loss. At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2025]] they handed [[New Jade]] theirs, and beat [[Artisian]] 19-16 in overtime.

A Major semifinal and an 11-6 record for the IGL.

"We beat everybody who won something this year," NipNip said. "Now we need to be the ones winning something."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #9 tanykeat
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[tanykeat]] was #7 on this list in 2021, when his [[Syzygy]] team beat [[Divide&Conquer]] in a winners' final and then lost the grand final to them. Four years later, he finally has a title.

It came at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]] with [[Alcheministry]]. They won six of seven maps, beating [[Unforgettable]], [[The Gigarage]] 13-2, [[Opal]], [[division20]], [[Aeternum]] and, in the match that settled first place, [[entity]] 13-7.

Alcheministry's year also included a 22-18 overtime win over [[99Lives]] at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]]. An 8-4 record and the first trophy of the IGL's career.

"Four years since Syzygy," tanykeat said. "I almost forgot what a final felt like. This one, I'll remember."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #8 SanCtuary
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[SanCtuary]] was our #1 player of 2022. In 2025 he is back in the top ten, still calling for [[Artisian]], still with the same five players.

Artisian played four big events and won 14 series, more than all but a handful of players in the league. At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]] they won all four group matches before a three-map quarterfinal loss to DiamondOnes. At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]] they beat [[Alcheministry]], the Reshuffle champions, 2-0 and reached the quarterfinals.

At the [[BPL Legends Stage 2025]] they finished sixth with five wins, including a 22-20 overtime win over [[Cyanide]] and a 13-1 win over [[Aimpunch]], who they had also beaten 13-7 at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]].

A 14-7 record from one of the best IGLs the league has seen.

"Four years with the same five players," SanCtuary said. "We don't need to talk much. We still talk too much."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #7 mmirawr_
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[mmirawr_]] was part of a [[The Gigarage]] team that didn't drop a map on the way to the 2025 Major final.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], The Gigarage swept [[New Jade]] in the group stage, [[Artisian]] in the quarterfinals and [[Round Loss Bonus]] in the semifinals, all 2-0. The final against [[Cosmos]] went the full five maps. Cosmos won it.

The Malaysian rifler's year had already shown what this team could do. At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]], they beat [[99Lives]] 13-0 and Fruit Basket 13-0 in back-to-back group matches. At the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]], they won five of seven.

An 11-5 record and a Major final.

"Two 13-0s in a row at the Audax," mmirawr_ said. "I didn't know you could do that to good teams."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #6 yunaeyo
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[yunaeyo]] has been with [[The Gigarage]] since their perfect [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]] run. In 2025 the American rifler took them to a Major final.

The Gigarage arrived at the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]] in form and played like it: [[New Jade]] 2-0, [[Artisian]] 2-0, [[Round Loss Bonus]] 2-0. Six maps won, none lost. The final against [[Cosmos]] went to a fifth map, and Cosmos took it.

Around the Major, The Gigarage were ninth at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]] and eighth at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]], winning eight of eleven group and Swiss matches across the two events.

An 11-5 record and a silver medal at the biggest event of the year.

"We've won a perfect event before," yunaeyo said. "Now we need to win the important one."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #5 kokushi_vampir
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[kokushi_vampir]]'s year started with [[Cosmos]] finishing 17th and ended with them as Major champions.

At the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]] in March, Cosmos lost to [[Neverland]] and [[Kiedz]] and went out in the group stage. At the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]] in June they improved to sixth, with five wins from seven, including 13-10 over [[Artisian]].

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]] they put it all together. Technomancy 2-0. [[entity]] 2-1. [[Aetherline]] 2-1. And a five-map final against [[The Gigarage]], won 3-2. The first title in Cosmos history.

An 11-4 record, and a rifler who was at his best in the deciders.

"From 17th to champions," kokushi_vampir said. "Somebody should write a book. Actually, don't. We're not done."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #4 gigichiii_
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[gigichiii_]] called [[The Gigarage]] to a perfect title run at the [[BPL Legends Stage 2023]], and was #13 on our list that year. In 2025 she took them to within one map of a Major.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], The Gigarage swept [[New Jade]], [[Artisian]] and [[Round Loss Bonus]] 2-0, six maps without a loss, and met [[Cosmos]] in the final. It went five maps. Cosmos won the last one.

It capped a year of steady excellence: three group wins, two of them 13-0, at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]], and five wins from seven at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]]. The Australian IGL is the highest-placed player on this list from a team that didn't win the Major.

"Two years ago we were perfect at the Legends Stage," gigichiii_ said. "This year we were one map short of perfect at the Major. I'll take the progress. I won't take the result."

title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #3 azzuto
author: BPL Staff
body:
[[azzuto]] won the deciders that won [[Cosmos]] their first title.

At the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2025]], Cosmos swept Technomancy and then needed a third map in both the quarterfinal and the semifinal, against [[entity]] and [[Aetherline]]. They won both. The final against [[The Gigarage]], who hadn't dropped a map all event, went to a fifth map. Cosmos won that too.

Before the Major, Cosmos had been steadily improving: 17th at the [[Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025]], sixth at the [[BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025]] with five wins from seven. Then they peaked at exactly the right moment.

An 11-4 record and a Major title for one of the sharpest riflers in the league.

"Three deciders in four series," azzuto said. "My heart rate still hasn't come down."

title: New Jade part ways with crazywhoopies; sign Kojadayo

body:
